cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Hand Over the Proof
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender information, evidence, a key, or access that would let you proceed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Give me the actual note, not your description.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm going inside.

beats.text: Granted. Take five.

cards.title: Steer the Suspicion
cards.instruction: Hide your responsibility by redirecting every new clue toward a safer explanation before anyone can connect it back to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The delivery must have cracked it when they squeezed past me. Photograph the pen too; that's a second claim.

cards.instruction: Get someone to reveal the motive behind a choice by offering small pieces of your own truth as bait.
